Convert an MNE-Python Raw object to a PhysioExperiment

Source: R/bridge-mne.R
fromMNE.Rd

Inverse of toMNE(): reads the signal matrix, channel names/types, sampling rate, electrode montage and annotations from an MNE Raw object into a PhysioExperiment. The import is recorded in the object's provenance.

Usage

fromMNE(raw)

Arguments

raw

An MNE Raw object (e.g. from toMNE() or mne.io.read_raw_*).

Value

A PhysioExperiment with the signal in the "raw" assay.

See also

toMNE(), hasMNE()

Examples

if (hasMNE()) {
  pe <- PhysioExperiment(
    assays = S4Vectors::SimpleList(raw = matrix(rnorm(300), 100, 3)),
    colData = S4Vectors::DataFrame(label = c("Fp1", "Fp2", "Cz"),
                                   type = rep("eeg", 3)),
    samplingRate = 100)
  pe2 <- fromMNE(toMNE(pe))
}
